channel.title: Farrelly Atkinson Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: “I think this is talent at this point”: Possibly the filthiest drivetrain this bike shop has ever laid eyes on; Jeremy Vine called “nasty” for filming law-breaking drivers; Was Wout van Aert sabotaged?; Extreme tyre clearance + more on the live blog
item.description: Dan Alexander is back on live blog duty to take you through the midway point in the week with all the news, reaction, silliness and more from the world of cycling this Wednesday

item.title: 3T Racemax 2 Italia
item.description: Stiff, aero and very well specced – the 3T a great choice if you're a racer with deep pockets

item.title: “Knifepoint” bikejacking in broad daylight captured on CCTV outside busy coffee shop
item.description: The incident is the latest in a line of violent bike thefts to have recently occurred. Met Police took two hours to respond to the incident.

item.title: Anti-terrorism barriers set to prevent cyclists from using pedestrianised Oxford Street, under latest TfL plans
item.description: Campaigners had welcomed the pedestrianisation proposal but want to see better cycling route alternatives

item.title: Backlash as road safety group tells cyclists to leave one metre when passing parked cars “to avoid being hit if a door is opened” — but riders in disbelief at advice not telling motorists to use Dutch Reach and look properly + more on the live blog
item.description: Spring is in the air and Dan Alexander might even get outside for a spin at some point (the temperature has creeped above his fair-weather threshold)... the rest of the day he'll be rounding-up all your Thursday live blog action

item.title: Q36.5 Dottore Hybrid Vest Check Orange
item.description: Light, wind-cutting gilet blending style and practicality – excellent for fast rides in late winter, spring and autumn

item.title: “We can’t expect him to follow Tadej at the Tour of Flanders”: Visma-Lease a Bike urge caution after Matthew Brennan’s classics breakthrough – but believe British wonderkid can win cycling’s biggest races
item.description: “He dreams of winning the biggest classics, winning stages at the Tour de France, winning the green jersey. He can aim very high. But he’s so young, he needs a few years to develop,” says sports director Grischa Niermann

item.title: Cycling MotoGP star filmed overtaking cars on descent criticised by Lidl-Trek after viral clip attracts controversy
item.description: “The behaviour shown by Aleix Espargaró does not reflect the values or standards that govern us as a team,” Lidl-Trek, who the Spaniard represents as an ambassador after a brief racing stint last year, said

item.title: Father of child knocked over by cyclist wins legal appeal – as court rules viral video “contributed to public debate on cyclists and pedestrians”
item.description: The cyclist was also ordered to pay over €2,000 in costs, after it was argued that he could not “provide any evidence that he was insulted” as a result of the clip

item.title: Giant unveils “lightest Propel ever”, shunning the trend towards more radical aero road bikes
item.description: Giant says the new Propel is its lightest yet, so where does that leave its own very popular TCR all-round road bike? I’ve ridden the new Liv EnviLiv - the women's version of the Propel - to see how the updates feel on the road
